label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.44… supports Whatever has its being by participation has…
note: q.44 a.1 ad 1 says being by participation entails being caused by another. The encoded statement keeps that clause, reads 'caused' as having a distinct cause of its being, and omits the clause that being caused is not part of the notion of being simply. It does not identify participated esse with Platonic participation.
